verdict.rationale: The only first-party sign of programmatic, non-browser access is the GST Developer Portal at an 'apiportal' URL, with Register and Login entry points. That suggests an API for automation, but the snippets describe no actual endpoints or capabilities. The GST Offline Tool for invoice upload is a manual desktop utility and the income-tax probe concerns a different portal, so neither counts. Missing for 10: documented API endpoints for filing and retrieval, a headless authentication flow suitable for unattended or CI use (e.g. tokens instead of an interactive login or DSC/EVC), any CLI or SDK, and any hands-on or independent confirmation of automated use.
